slides.title: A true story
slides.transcript: [warmly] Loza the Cat. A true story, for Noah. <break time="0.5s" /> [gently] From a street in Cairo, all the way to a home in San Diego.

slides.title: A Street in Cairo
slides.transcript: [warmly] A Street in Cairo. <break time="0.4s" /> Once, in a busy street in Cairo, there was a tiny white kitten with one blue eye and one green eye. She was all alone, and she was hungry. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Mew… mew…

slides.title: Gedo Found Her
slides.transcript: [warmly] Gedo Found Her. <break time="0.4s" /> Then Gedo came walking down the street. He saw the little kitten, bent down, and scooped her up in his warm hands. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Don't be scared, little one.

slides.title: The Big Airplane
slides.transcript: [warmly] The Big Airplane. <break time="0.4s" /> Gedo could not leave her behind. So Loza flew with him across the sea, all the way to America — all the way to California. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Up, up, up in the sky!

slides.title: Baba and Mama
slides.transcript: [warmly] Baba and Mama. <break time="0.4s" /> Then Baba Ahmed and Mama opened their door and their hearts. They took Loza home to San Diego, where the sea is blue and the sun is warm. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Welcome home, Loza.

slides.title: And Then Noah
slides.transcript: [warmly] And Then Noah. <break time="0.4s" /> Then one day a very small baby came home. Loza crept close, sniffed his tiny toes, and lay down beside him to keep watch. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Hello, Noah.

slides.title: Loza and Noah Play
slides.transcript: [warmly] Loza and Noah Play. <break time="0.4s" /> Now Loza and Noah play every day. She chases the yarn. She hides in her cosy cave. Where is Loza? <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Peekaboo!

slides.title: Two Different Eyes
slides.transcript: [warmly] Two Different Eyes. <break time="0.4s" /> Loza has one blue eye, blue like the sea in San Diego. And one green eye, green like the palm trees in Cairo. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] One blue, one green.

slides.title: Loza’s Happy Days
slides.transcript: [warmly] Loza’s Happy Days. <break time="0.4s" /> The sunny window in the morning. Baba’s lap in the evening. Mama’s kitchen whenever something smells good. And Noah to play with all day long. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] A very happy cat.

slides.title: Goodnight, Loza
slides.transcript: [softly] Goodnight, Loza. <break time="0.4s" /> Goodnight Gedo. Goodnight Baba. Goodnight Mama. Goodnight Loza, curled up at the end of the bed. <break time="0.5s" /> [whispers] Goodnight, Noah.
